q: The medicine must stay below 8°C; it may lose effectiveness ___ it is kept in a refrigerator during transport.

exp.trans: 这种药必须保持在8摄氏度以下；运输途中如果不放在冰箱里，它可能会失去药效。
exp.structure: 分号前：The medicine（主语）+ must stay（谓语）+ below 8°C（补足信息）。分号后主干：it（主语）+ may lose（谓语）+ effectiveness（宾语）。unless引导条件状语从句：it is kept in a refrigerator during transport，相当于 if it is not kept...。
exp.other: effectiveness 有效性；refrigerator 冰箱；during transport 在运输过程中；keep sth below... 使某物保持在……以下。
exp.meaning: unless = if...not，表示“除非/如果不”。这里逻辑是：不冷藏 → 可能失效。
exp.rest: because表示原因，会变成“因为被冷藏所以失效”，逻辑相反；although表示让步，不能表达必要条件；so that表示目的/结果，通常是“为了……”，与这里的风险条件不符。

q: The northern reservoir filled rapidly after weeks of rain. ___, the southern reservoir continued to fall because the storm never reached that region.

exp.trans: 连续数周降雨后，北部水库水位迅速上升。相反，南部水库的水位却继续下降，因为暴雨根本没有到达那个地区。
exp.structure: 第一句主干：The northern reservoir + filled。第二句主干：the southern reservoir + continued to fall；because从句解释下降原因。连接词要概括两句之间的相反关系。
exp.other: reservoir 水库；rapidly 迅速地；continue to fall 持续下降；region 地区。
exp.meaning: Conversely表示“相反地、反过来”，用于前后趋势明显对立。
exp.rest: Similarly表示相似关系，但一边上升、一边下降不相似；Therefore表示因果，第二句不是第一句造成的；For example引出例子，但第二句是在对照另一地区。

q: Which sentence has a clean parallel structure in which the same modal verb governs both alternatives?
o: The technician can either replace the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician either can replace the sensor or recalibration of the device.
The technician can either replacing the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician can either replace the sensor or the device is recalibrated.

exp.trans: 正确句：技术员可以要么更换传感器，要么重新校准设备。
exp.structure: 主干：The technician（主语）+ can（情态动词）+ either replace... or recalibrate...。can同时支配replace和recalibrate，两边都是动词原形，结构完全平行。
exp.other: technician 技术员；sensor 传感器；recalibrate 重新校准；device 设备。
exp.meaning: 共同动词支配时，并列两端应保持同一语法层级。这里 can + replace / recalibrate。
exp.rest: either can replace... or recalibration... 把动词结构和名词结构并列；can either replacing... 中情态动词后不能接-ing形式；replace... or the device is recalibrated 把动词短语和完整从句并列，层级不一致。

q: A paragraph begins: “Overall, the first phase cut waiting times but raised operating costs.” The article then spends two more paragraphs discussing why costs rose. What does Overall most likely do here?
o: It proves the article has reached its final sentence.
It summarizes the first phase before the article moves to further analysis.
It introduces a completely unrelated example.
It means the following claim is uncertain.

exp.trans: 段落开头说：“总体来看，第一阶段缩短了等待时间，但提高了运营成本。”随后文章又用两段分析成本为何上升。这里 Overall 最可能是在进一步分析之前概括第一阶段的总体结果。
exp.structure: 引号内主干：the first phase（主语）+ cut / raised（并列谓语）+ waiting times / operating costs（宾语）。Overall修饰整句判断，表示概括性评价；后文仍可继续展开。
exp.other: phase 阶段；waiting time 等待时间；operating cost 运营成本；further analysis 进一步分析。
exp.meaning: Overall是句子/段落层面的总结副词，表示“总体而言”；它不等于“全文到此结束”。
exp.rest: 总结词可以出现在文章中段，不能凭Overall就判断是最后一句；unrelated example是引例功能，与概括相反；Overall不表达不确定性，uncertain更接近possibly/apparently等语气词。

q: After several weeks of physiotherapy, the patient regained enough muscle tone to stand without assistance. Here, muscle tone refers to:

exp.trans: 经过几周的物理治疗后，患者恢复了足够的肌张力，可以在无人帮助的情况下站立。
exp.structure: 主干：the patient（主语）+ regained（谓语）+ enough muscle tone（宾语）。to stand without assistance表示恢复到足以站立的结果/程度。
exp.other: physiotherapy 物理治疗；regain 恢复；assistance 帮助；stand 站立。
exp.meaning: muscle tone是固定医学表达，指肌张力。
exp.rest: tone可表示语气、色调、音调，但muscle明确限定了词义；说话语气常见tone of voice，肤色常见skin tone，音高通常是pitch。

q: If the wind weakens before noon, the ferry could conceivably resume service this afternoon, but the operator has made no promise. Conceivably most nearly means:
o: 有这种可能，但不能确定

exp.trans: 如果中午前风势减弱，渡轮今天下午有可能恢复运营，但运营方没有作出任何保证。
exp.structure: if从句给出条件：the wind weakens before noon。主句：the ferry + could resume + service；conceivably修饰could resume，降低确定性。but后面的no promise进一步说明并不确定。
exp.other: weaken 减弱；ferry 渡轮；resume service 恢复运营；operator 运营方。
exp.meaning: conceivably = 可以设想地、有可能地，强调可能存在但远未确定。
exp.rest: 必然地接近certainly/inevitably，语气过强；故意地是deliberately/intentionally；表面上地是apparently/superficially，均不符合could...but no promise的弱可能语境。

q: A tiny crack in the package seal can compromise the sterility of the medical instrument. Here, compromise means:

exp.trans: 包装密封处的一条细小裂缝就可能破坏医疗器械的无菌状态。
exp.structure: 主干：A tiny crack in the package seal（主语）+ can compromise（谓语）+ the sterility of the medical instrument（宾语）。这里主语是裂缝，不存在谈判双方。
exp.other: crack 裂缝；seal 密封处；sterility 无菌状态；medical instrument 医疗器械。
exp.meaning: compromise作及物动词可表示损害、削弱、危及，常见搭配有compromise safety/security/quality。
exp.rest: 谈判折中义常见reach a compromise或compromise on an issue；measure表示测量；praise表示赞扬。裂缝能造成的是无菌性受损，而不是协商。

target: with + 名词 + 后置成分
skill: with + 名词 + 后置修饰
q: The audience waited quietly, with the lights gradually dimming before the film began. The with-structure mainly:
o: means the audience waited together with the lights

exp.trans: 观众安静地等待着，电影开始前，灯光正逐渐变暗。
exp.structure: 主干：The audience（主语）+ waited（谓语）+ quietly（状语）。原始简单句：The lights were gradually dimming before the film began. → 去掉were，用with引出：with the lights gradually dimming...。the lights是with结构的逻辑主语，dimming与lights构成主动关系。
exp.other: audience 观众；gradually 逐渐地；dim 变暗；before the film began 电影开始前。
exp.meaning: with + 名词 + 后置成分可补充主句发生时的伴随状态或背景。
exp.rest: 目的通常用to do/in order to；with结构不是新的独立主句；这里with不是“和灯光一起”等普通介词伴随对象，而是带逻辑主语和分词的复合结构。

q: Complete the pair correctly: “The slippery floor ___ condensation on the tiles; the accident later ___ a temporary closure of the corridor.”

exp.trans: 湿滑的地面是由瓷砖上的冷凝水造成的；之后那起事故又导致走廊临时关闭。
exp.structure: 第一分句：The slippery floor（结果）+ resulted from（谓语短语）+ condensation（原因）。第二分句：the accident（原因）+ resulted in（谓语短语）+ a temporary closure（结果）。
exp.other: slippery 湿滑的；condensation 冷凝水/凝结；temporary 临时的；corridor 走廊。
exp.meaning: result from = 由……导致，主语是结果；result in = 导致……，主语是原因。
exp.rest: resulted in / resulted from把因果方向完全颠倒；两个都用resulted from会把第二句说成“事故源于关闭”；两个都用resulted in会把第一句说成“地面导致冷凝水”，均与常识和句意相反。

q: Although she runs a large laboratory, Dr. Lin has little use for formal titles and asks everyone to call her by her first name. Here, has little use for means:

exp.trans: 虽然林博士管理着一个大型实验室，但她并不看重正式头衔，并让大家直接叫她的名字。
exp.structure: Although引导让步从句：she + runs + a large laboratory。主句：Dr. Lin（主语）+ has little use for（谓语表达）+ formal titles（宾语）；and连接第二个谓语asks，asks everyone to call... 是ask sb to do结构。
exp.other: laboratory 实验室；formal title 正式头衔；first name 名；ask sb to do 要求某人做某事。
exp.meaning: have little use for sth常表示不喜欢、不看重、认为没什么价值，不是字面上的“很少使用”。
exp.rest: 几乎没有机会使用强调客观使用频率，但后文主动要求直呼名字说明是态度；寻找替代品需search for alternatives；谨慎使用是use carefully，均不是该习语义。
